caveats: ⚑ skill1 hitCount:40 counts ROUNDS. Base is SMG with hitsPerShot 2 — if the engine counts each trigger pull as 1 round the buff fires every 40 pulls; if it counts landed hits it fires every 20 pulls, doubling uptime. Unverified which the kit means by 'normal attacks'.
⚑ skill1 attackSpeedPct 7.26% for 3s on a ~40-attack cycle is a very low-duty-cycle buff; its board contribution is near-noise and is a poor discriminator for validating the trigger encoding.

Max-HP gates (skill2 whole block, burst 924% branch) are modeled as ALWAYS-TRUE: the scope-lock boss deals no damage and the sim models no HP pool, so the unit never leaves Max HP. This is faithful AT SCOPE ONLY — on any content where the unit takes damage both would intermittently drop, and neither is currently expressible as a gate.

burst 924% is authored as a SEPARATE flatDamage, not merged into 1320%, so the Max-HP branch stays independently togglable if HP is ever modeled. Split-vs-merge is popup-readable and unverified: if real footage shows ONE popup the two should merge.
⚑ noFb:true on both burst branches follows the hard rule that burst-cast damage lands before the Full Burst window opens; measured-only per the ALWAYS-⚑ taxonomy, not read off this kit text.
⚑ cadence tuple (ammo 120, reloadFrames 141, hitsPerShot 2, chargeFrames 0) is datamined and known-unreliable; a nominal rate_of_fire is quantized to 60fps frame boundaries.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Soline is a structurally simple SMG/Iron/Attacker B3: no weapon swap, no stacks/currency, no DoT, no resource pool, no cross-unit or tandem effects, no team-facing buff of any kind — every line is self-scoped or enemy-damage. S1 is a low-duty-cycle self Attack Speed pulse on a 40-normal-attack counter (a weapon-state modifier, so it IS damage: it gates shots fired). S2 is a permanent self crit pair (generic, NOT normal-attack-scoped — the text carries no scope word), gated on Max HP, which is scope-trivially always-true. Burst is pure instant damage in two branches, 396% unconditional + 924% at Max HP, both crit-eligible at the caster's sheet rate, neither core (the text never says 'core strike'), both FB-exempt as burst-cast damage. Nothing in this kit is skipped — unmodeled is empty for all three slots.

flags.reasoning: '40 normal attacks' is a ROUND count, but the base carries hitsPerShot 2, so a hit-based reading would fire the buff twice as often (every ~20 pulls) and double its uptime. The kit text cannot distinguish 'attack' = pull vs = landed hit, and this is the single largest structural uncertainty in the kit.
flags.recipe: DBG_BUFFS=1 on a solo run: log every attackSpeedPct buffApply frame and divide by the shot count between applications. Cross-check against footage — the buff icon should appear at a fixed, countable shot interval; 40 pulls vs 20 pulls is unmistakable on an ammo counter.

flags.reasoning: The buff's board contribution is the product of magnitude (small) and duty cycle (unknown, set by the count:40 question above). At a nominal SMG cadence a 40-round cycle is short enough that 3s of +7.26% may be near-continuous, or sparse — the two readings differ by ~2x in effective uptime. Datamined rate_of_fire is itself an ALWAYS-⛑ field (nominal, quantized to 60fps frame boundaries), so the duty cycle is not derivable from the datamine alone.
flags.recipe: Measure real shots/sec directly off the ammo counter (the instrument that measures the disputed quantity), not off FB counts; combine with the resolved count:40 semantics to get true uptime, then A/B the buff on/off.

flags.reasoning: Hard rule: burst-cast/instant damage is always FB-exempt because a burst cast lands before the Full Burst window opens (a verified-facts item, not a per-unit read). Listed here because per-kit noFb is in the ALWAYS-⛑ taxonomy as measured-only and must never ship silently.
flags.recipe: Popup-read the burst hits against the FB banner frame: if the 396%/924% popups precede the banner they take no +50% major. Confirm via a damage event's fbMajorApplied flag on a burstCast-triggered flatDamage.

flags.estimate: SPLIT — two flatDamage entries (396 + 924), not one 1320
flags.reasoning: Kit-silent per the ALWAYS-⛑ taxonomy; unreadable from prose. Split preserves the Max-HP branch as an independently togglable unit if an HP pool is ever modeled, and is damage-identical to a merge at scope lock (both branches always fire, same flags, same bucket). The only observable difference is popup count.
flags.recipe: Read the burst popups in footage: ONE popup at the combined value → merge to 1320%; TWO popups → keep split. Damage-neutral either way at scope, so this is a faithfulness call, not an accuracy one.

flags.reasoning: The sim has no HP pool and the scope-lock boss deals no damage, so the unit is permanently at Max HP; a gate would be a no-op that never evaluates false. Flagged because this is a real kit condition being silently satisfied by the scope, not by faithfulness — roughly half this unit's kit value (924 of 1320 burst % plus the whole crit pair) rides on it.
flags.recipe: No sim-side test discriminates this at scope. If HP modeling ever lands, both sites need a real gate; until then verify only that the schema has no suitable primitive (there is no requiresMaxHp block gate in types.ts) and keep the caveat live.
